method: Rebuilt the September 2026 curriculum from both adopted TLS appendices, checked the catalogued course IDs against the newer programme, and separately read the public placement and thesis rules before reconsidering the frozen comparison.
findings: Articles 7 and 8 govern September 2026 entrants, while Articles 7a and 8a cover earlier entrants. The first-year 9 EC research unit and 3 EC history unit are current. Article 8 fills the year-two catalogue blank with 6 EC of Public Administration Research 2. The formal third-year table names The World’s Legal Systems and the 12 EC placement instead of the catalogue’s older legal and placement shells. The route reconciles to 60 EC each year.

The new placement page confirms 90 EC before entry and at least 40 working days. The older 60 EC rule cross-references the earlier cohort’s placement. The 12 EC thesis requires 102 EC by release of block 1 grades. A student who completed the first two years has 120 EC and meets both thresholds. The thesis starts with a proposal in block 2 and concludes with desk research and an oral assessment. The 18 EC minor space remains open and international study requires approval.

The closest option uses Public Policy Analysis with public economics, political institutions and comparative law. The organisations option adds Public Policy Analysis and Governance of Sustainability to leadership and civic inquiry, without implying specialist municipal management. The law option uses EU law, EU politics, comparative constitutional law and human rights with ethics, historical research and public economics. All three pass feasibility and differ by 67.5, 60 and 97.5 EC each way.

Reviewed the 27 external titles and credits, all 39 selected titles and descriptions, the three audience concepts, five notes, qualified alignments and official links. The compulsory Tilburg placement and thesis have no paired UCR equivalents. Optional UCR research is separate from scheduled coursework.
